notes.title: Our Major Summer Update Is Here: New Character, New Setting, New Abilities
notes.notes:
To start off our major Summer update, we are introducing an all-new character: Doctor Mallory!

After the Queen of the Monarch (and Sherring Ford's nemesis) perished at Meiringen Falls as depicted in our manga, ESPIONAGE ZERO: Chapter Two (which is available to read now, FREE!), all that was left behind was foreboding. As the first of our Legacy Characters, in which those who have had a profound effect on the game's timeline can return as playable characters with special lore reveals in tow, Dr. Mallory will be unlockable starting on Monday!


Mallory's Special Abilities
1️⃣ Prime Variable
Publicly assigns an extra vote to the target in the upcoming Voting Phase while also allowing the user to cast a normal vote. This can serve as a nomination if at least one other player is nominated; if not, this effect is canceled.

2️⃣ Relative Symmetry
Forces two targets to exchange their Special Ability sets with one another. Does not refresh Special Ability usages for either target and cannot include a target already removed from play.


New Costume Added
🛍️Inquisitor Mallory
A respected academic by day but malefactor by night, Mallory assumes her role as the latter while attending an esteemed production at the Royal Opera in London—but with a peculiar aim...


New Special Ability Reworks!
As part of this update, many abilities are being completely reworked:

✨Dreams of Winter: Establish one-sided Trust with a target that can see the user's Intel but not vice versa. If full Trust is reached later, the user's Current AP is refilled once per match.

✨Mircalla: Transfers all AP used by a secret target of her choice to her, until the end of her second turn after activation.

✨Group Therapy: At the cost of 45 from his AP Limit, reduce the Suspicion of two targets by the amount of Trust he has with each target.

✨Jury Duty: Choose a target who, during their next turn, must use a doubled Suspicion or Trust action on a target of their choice. This action cannot be debated or interrupted.

✨Survival Bias: Choose a secret target. All Suspicion gains for the rest of the round that affect the user will be switched to the target at the end of the round. This ability appears as a Recuse during the turn it is used and does not apply to actions initiated by the target.

✨Collective Amnesia: Reset all Suspicion, including his own, to 0 until the start of the next round. At that point, all previous Suspicion values are re-added on top of the existing totals.

✨Hypnotherapy: Allows him to re-use a Special Ability already used by another player (except Persuasion) at the cost of 45 from his AP Limit. [Survival Bias may now be used with Hypnotherapy and its cost was increased from 30 :greenarrow: 45]

New Setting: Mirror Selections
🎨 Use any number of duplicate characters and costumes in a match!

Please post any feedback on our Discord server!

notes.title: December 12, 2023 — Various Bugfixes and Issues Resolved
notes.notes:
The following updates are now live and should greatly improve the player experience:

[olist]
 Fixes for a crash related to launching the game in Portuguese, Spanish (Latino), Spanish (EU), or Vietnamese.
 An issue preventing login and account creation has been fixed.
 The Civilian ability Dying Message has been fixed and should now show feedback upon being selected.
 A bug that prevented AP from being hidden while setting Show AP was enabled, and thus would reveal the Supporter if Protect was used successfully, has been fixed.
 Uses of Moran's Special Ability Sharpshooter in TEAM ESPIONAGE should now behave as intended.
 A bug preventing the Informant from being able to use both Impair and Execute within the same match has been fixed.
 You can again set player counts to lower than 8 while ESPIONAGE is set as the mode. TEAM ESPIONAGE still requires 8 players.
 A bug with Collective Amnesia has been resolved. In rare situations, this ability would not properly deduct the AP cost.
 More visual feedback is now available as you use Dying Message.
 A bug that, in some very rare situations, caused the Informant to wrongly lose access to Execute when the Spy used Eliminate has been fixed. To clarify, Execute is only considered used if it is successful.
 A bug related to dialogue has been fixed in which text would not properly match between the targets, debater, and proposer.
 The Fast Forward ⏩ function now prevents the AI from performing otherwise disallowed actions (such as recusing once targeted by Persuasion). A related bug in which the AI would sometimes recuse in a similar situation outside of Fast Forward was also fixed.
 A target of Execute should now be ineligible to be dragged and dropped, and also cannot be added to the Notebook.
 Upon disconnecting, a teammate could create an unintended animation and UI placement error. This has been fixed. Missing sound effects related to disconnections should be fixed as well.
 Various backend problems have been resolved.
 Some AI updates have been made. Further updates are coming over the next few days.
 Your equipped costumes will now be shown on the CHARACTERS submenu. Additionally, a bug that showed the default costumes upon choosing a character has been resolved: your equipped costumes will now always show as intended in that situation.
 Mode Selection is now available on additional menus used for creating and adjusting lobbies.
 Various UI adjustments have been made, including in the EXPLORE menu options, the PLAY header on the main menu, character and costume name design changes on profiles and within the shop, and many more.
 In TEAM ESPIONAGE, when involved in a debate with your partner, the UI related to Suspicion now shows — to indicate no change will take place for that element.
 An Eliminate animation bug during Protect has been resolved.
 A display bug that could happen during a Tiebreaker has been fixed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Notes for January 29, 2023
notes.notes:
The January update for  ESPIONAGE: Mafia Evolved is now live!

1️⃣ New Costume Added:
🌟 GRADUATE RUIKO
This is the first costume that launches with three total colors! All future costumes will launch with just as many, if not more.

2️⃣ New Costume Color Added:
🌟 RETIRED SHERRING (Alternative Version)
This is only the first of many new alternate colors for existing costumes. This costume can only be unlocked by completing in-game challenges and thus acquiring gameplay currency.

3️⃣ Visual Fixes:
🌟 A few visual bugs previously reported have been resolved, including a Player List display error in which avatars were not being shown in the correct aspect ratio. An issue within the shop that would result in a scrolling issue with text boxes has also been fixed. Some rarer bugs that made certain functions within the lobby inaccessible have been fixed, along with a bug that caused some chat issues.

4️⃣ We are now accepting sign-ups for AI Playtesting:
🌟 ESPIONAGE: Mafia Evolved will soon have full AI player support: play alone, play with a full lobby of humans, or play with a combination of AI and humans. If a human player ever disconnects, don't worry—AI Takeover means an AI who has all information from that player's perspective will take their place until they return.

Click here to join our Discord server if you would like to help us playtest the AI early!

5️⃣ What's next? 

🌟 2023 Major Update #1—
The very next major update will be the start of Season 2, which will include not just full AI support but also the very first Master Costume! This costume will be for one of the original eight characters, with others to steadily follow in further updates. If you have this character to Level 50 already, you will have it unlocked for free immediately upon loading the game after the launch of Season 2. If you haven't reached Level 50 with this character by then, don't worry: anyone who reaches Level 50 with a character, at any time, will always receive their Master Costume free once it is made available within the game.

Beyond this, we have much more including 2nd Special Abilities for all characters and Action Phase abilities for all roles.

notes.title: November 20, 2022 — New Costume, New Setting, and Balance Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
The latest update for: ESPIONAGE: Mafia Evolved is now live!

1️⃣ New costume added: ESCAPIST RAFFLES

2️⃣ Balance Changes:
🌟 Raffles's Special Ability 「Amateur Cracksman」 upgraded: Instead of receiving 20 AP per target to his Current AP total, he will now receive 35 AP per target.
🌟 Ruiko's Special Ability 「Divine Instinct」 changed slightly: Instead of a penalty of -60 AP to her Max AP, the penalty will now be -50 AP.
🌟 Marimede's Special Ability 「Nemesis」 changed slightly: Instead of a penalty of -40 AP to her Max AP, the penalty will now be -30 AP.
🌟 Seward's Special Ability 「Group Therapy」 changed slightly: Instead of gaining only a third of Trust with all players, he now gains a little more (the equivalent of one extra Trust).

3️⃣ New match setting: Show AP — The current AP of all players will be visible. If the Spy is penalized for targeting the wrong players with Eliminate, AP is then hidden for the remainder of the match.

4️⃣ Animation issue has been fixed that sometimes showed transparent art in gameplay.

5️⃣ General UI improvements have been made.

6️⃣ Localization updates have been made for various languages.

Our 2023 roadmap will be revealed in December! Keep an eye out for all that we have in store and thank you again for playing!
